## GHCode

GHCode is a browser-native GitHub development workbench integrating desired-state specification, repository inspection, qualified delta and reviewed issue dispatch.

Its UI uses React/TypeScript, Dockview, Monaco, Radix, Motion and Lucide Animated. The main Dockview always displays its tab strip: Overview, Specification, Delta, Repository, editors and other tools are peers. The activity rail activates native tabs while keeping a single project/ref selection, Explorer, editor system and status bar. The monochrome palette is retained.

### Open a project

Use the repository control in the global header. Files in the selected GitHub revision and local overlays inform all perspectives. Production is built from verified `main` through GitHub Pages Actions artifacts. PR source is never published under the authenticated production origin.

_Source: [0001-overview.md](notes/0001-overview.md)_


## Contributing and architecture map

Feature PRs go to `development`; only a reviewed `development` PR can target `main`. Source requirements are in `.agents/requests/`, accepted architecture in `.agents/decisions/`, published README notes in `.agents/notes/`, and operative rules in `.agents/rules/`.

Generate the project documents with `python3 .github/scripts/generate_documents.py --write` and check with `--check`. Run `bun run check`, `bun run acceptance`, and Python test discovery for changes. All repository tests and support mocks belong below `.github/tests/`.

`src/workbench/` owns shell, tabs and layout; `src/workspace/` owns GitHub project state; `src/factory/` derives specification and difference projections; `src/tabs/` owns editor and GitHub views. `.github/workflows/` owns native deployment and release actions.

_Source: [0002-contributing.md](notes/0002-contributing.md)_
